coverage_notes: The APA referral applies explicitly to final article manuscripts, not an inferred production layout.
Author-selected APA-permitted Times New Roman 12 bp branch; APA permits other fonts and does not require this font uniquely.
No publisher sample text, title-page content, running head, numbering, reference content or inline punctuation is rewritten.
APA levels 4 and 5 are run-in headings. Their placement/case/punctuation and split caption components are retained as facts, not silently approximated as whole-paragraph style.
APA table cells permit 1, 1.5, or 2 line spacing. This selected branch chooses 2; figure image typography is separate from caption typography.
